Chrome.desktop: Open Chrome > click the lock 🔒 icon to the left of the URL > Permissions > Location > set to 'Allow' OR go Settings > Privacy & security > Site Settings > Location and choose 'Sites can ask to use your location' then allow InstaPay.
Chrome.mobile: Open Chrome app > Menu (⋮) > Settings > Privacy and security > Site Settings > Location > turn on 'Sites can ask to use your location', then allow InstaPay on prompt.

Safari.desktop: Safari > Preferences (or Settings) > Websites > Location > find your site and set to 'Allow'. Also make sure Mac system Location Services are on.
Safari.iOS: Open iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services > ensure Location Services is on > scroll to Safari Websites and set 'While Using the App' or 'Ask'.

Firefox.desktop: Click the Permissions (lock/🛡️) icon left of URL > Settings next to 'Location' > change from 'Block' to 'Allow' or 'Ask'. OR go Firefox Settings > Privacy & Security > Permissions > Location Settings and update it.
Firefox.mobile: Open Firefox app > Menu > Settings > Permissions > Location > set to 'Ask' or 'Allow'.

Edge.desktop: Click lock 🔒 icon next to the URL > Permissions for this site > Location > set to 'Allow', or Settings > Cookies & site permissions > Location > set to 'Ask before accessing' and allow InstaPay.
Edge.mobile: Open Edge app > Menu > Settings > Privacy and security > Site permissions > Location > set to 'Ask' or 'Allow' for InstaPay.

Samsung Browser.mobile: Open Samsung Internet > Menu > Settings > Site permissions > Location > toggle 'Location access' on, then allow InstaPay when prompted.

Brave.desktop: Click lock 🔒 or Brave Shields 🦁 icon in address bar > Site settings > Location > set to 'Allow', or go Settings > Privacy & security > Site & Shield Settings > Location and allow.
Brave.mobile: Open Brave app > Menu > Settings > Site settings > Location > set to 'Ask' or 'Allow' for InstaPay.

Default.instruction: Please check your browser settings to allow location access for InstaPay. This is needed to get your location; you must enable 'Ask' or 'Allow' manually if it's blocked.
